transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you here today?

Um... I guess what made me ask for help is... I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, and... I just sit there staring at food I used to like. I end up throwing most of it away. So... yeah. That's it, mostly.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, like hobbies or activities you once liked?

Yeah, I guess. I used to like doing things... going to gallery nights, playing basketball with some guys, getting food-truck tacos... even helping kids with art stuff. But now... I don't know. I just kind of stand around feeling... flat. I usually just make an excuse to leave early.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or blaming yourself for things lately?

Um... maybe. I don't know. 

They... they gave me this award at the store recently. And a chance at being a supervisor. But... I just keep thinking I don't deserve it. I kind of feel guilty, honestly... like I somehow tricked everyone into picking me. People keep telling me I didn't, but... yeah. I don't know.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... about two months, I think. 

It kind of started around the time they gave me that award... for the window display. The district manager was paying a lot of attention to me, and... yeah. Since then, mostly.
Have you noticed that you're feeling more tired or that you're lacking energy lately, even if you're not doing much?

Yeah... I guess so. 

Um... by the middle of a shift, my body just feels really heavy. Like... even just straightening the racks or having to walk back to the stockroom. It just takes more out of me than it should. I don't really know why.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual or that you can't sit still lately?

Um... no, not really. I don't think so. 

I mean, I'm tired, like I said, but... I don't think I'm moving any slower than normal. And I can sit still fine. So... yeah, no.
Have you had trouble sleeping lately, like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early?

Yeah... I guess sleep hasn't been great. 

Um... most nights I just lie there. I keep replaying that award thing in my head, and... just conversations from the store. Then if I do actually fall asleep, I end up waking up way too early. And I just... I can't get my mind to shut back off after that. So... yeah.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble with sleep and energy?

Um... no. Not really. 

I mean... I don't know. I guess I've had bad days before, but... not like this. Not where it just keeps going on and on. So... no.
Have you ever had any other times in your life when your mood was really low, you lost interest in things, or you had trouble sleeping or eating?
Um... I think I just said that. But... no. I mean, not really. I've never had a time like this before. So... no.
Have you noticed that others have commented on your movements being slower or faster than usual, or that you’ve been fidgety or restless without meaning to?
Um... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anyone saying anything like that. I just... I don't know, I guess I just try to keep to myself mostly. So, no.
Have you ever had any other times in your life when your mood was really low, you lost interest in things, or you had trouble sleeping or eating?
Didn't you... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said before... no. I haven't.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or treated for any mental health conditions in the past, like depression or anxiety?
Um... no. I've never seen a doctor for anything like that before. So... no.
Have you ever had any thoughts about harming yourself or that life isn't worth living?
No... um, not really. I don't... I wouldn't do anything like that. So, no.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?

Um... yeah, I guess so. At work, I just... I keep losing my place on simple stuff. Like counting inventory, or... or even just picking colors for a display. I don't know, I just end up second-guessing myself over things I used to do fast. So... yeah, it's been harder.
Have you been feeling like you're a failure or that you've let others down, even if you know it's not entirely your fault?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I got this award at work recently, and they talked about making me a supervisor. But... I don't know, I just keep thinking I don't deserve it. Like I tricked them somehow. People say I earned it, but... I just feel guilty, I guess. Like I'm faking it. So... yeah.
Have you ever had a period in your life lasting two weeks or more when you felt down most of the day, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping or eating?
Um... I don't know. I mean... I guess I've been feeling down lately, but... I don't really keep track of how long it's been. So... I'm not really sure about two weeks. Just... lately, I guess.
Have you ever had a time in your life, lasting at least two weeks, where you felt down most of the day, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping or eating, even before this current period?
Um... no. I don't... I don't really think so. Just... what's happening now, I guess. I don't really remember anything like that before.
Have you ever had an episode like this before—where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble sleeping or eating—for at least two weeks, even if it was a while ago?
No... I just said I didn't. I don't think so. Just this time.
